title: Approved Kernel Extensions
description: Lets kernel extensions load without the user approving them, by team ID or bundle ID.

AllowNonAdminUserApprovals.title: Allow non admin user approvals
AllowNonAdminUserApprovals.description: If true, nonadministrative users can approve additional kernel extensions in the Security & Privacy preferences.

AllowUserOverrides.title: Allow user overrides
AllowUserOverrides.description: If true, users can approve additional kernel extensions that configuration profiles don't explicitly allow.

AllowedKernelExtensions.title: Allowed kernel extensions
AllowedKernelExtensions.description: The dictionary that represents a set of kernel extensions that the system always allows to load on the computer. The dictionary maps team identifiers (keys) to arrays of bundle identifiers.

AllowedTeamIdentifiers.title: Allowed team identifiers
AllowedTeamIdentifiers.description: The array of team identifiers that define which validly signed kernel extensions can load.
